visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A calico cat stands on a bed with white patterned sheets in a dimly lit indoor room. In the background, a shelf holds various items, and a black-and-white cat is seen on a dresser playing with a red stuffed toy. The lighting is warm and low. (2) The shot cuts to a close-up of the black-and-white cat, which is biting and kicking the red plush toy with high energy. The background includes a large TV screen and household clutter on the furniture. (3) A man with glasses and dyed blonde hair is shown from the chest up. One cat is perched on his shoulders, and another is sniffing near his neck. He has a squinted, strained facial expression as if the cat's weight is significant. (4) The scene returns to the calico cat on the bed. The cat is kneading the duvet with its front paws in a repetitive motion. A human hand enters the frame and begins petting the cat's back. (5) The hand starts rhythmically patting the cat's rear end (butt-patting). The cat continues to knead the bed, its tail moving slightly. A TV in the background displays an anime scene. (6) The rhythmic patting continues for several seconds. The camera remains steady on the cat, capturing its focused kneading behavior and the constant interaction with the human hand.
